basic_info.main_problem: 我经常觉得自己是个糟糕的Athlete，并在体育课或其他体能活动表现not佳后产生Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts about athletic ability are affecting my self-esteem and my enjoyment of sports and activities, and I hope to improve this situation.
growth_experiences: 开始参加课后武术课程后，因在课堂上动作做错或表现not如Anticipation，逐渐将一次失误泛化为对整体能力的negate，开始给自己贴上“糟糕的Athlete”的标签，并感到尴尬。
加入学校安全巡逻队后感到需要表现Good的Increased stress，担心自己在新角色中的表现not佳会带来负面评价，这一压力与对体育表现的Self-doubt相互影响。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough，体能活动上not太可能变好

special_situations.event: 武术课上做错动作或表现not如Anticipation，且感到尴尬
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在do not人面前出错，就证明我have not天赋，今后也not会变好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过阅读小说Displacement注意力，避免与朋友讨论Self-doubt以减少被评价的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很差劲，我永远都not会变好了。

special_situations.event: 在任何体育活动或比赛中表现not如自己的期望
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次表现not好就能证明我对所有体能活动都not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowers participation enthusiasm, labels oneself negatively to avoid having hopes dashed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在所有运动上都很糟。

special_situations.event: After joining the school safety patrol, feeling role expectations and performance pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在新角色上表现not好，大家会认为我not行、会失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 增加Self-monitoring与担忧，避免向朋友寻求情感支持
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我做not好，大家就会看not起我。

special_situations.event: 在课堂上被同学或教练看到自己失误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要出错就说明我not适合运动，失败等于全盘negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Blames himself and temporarily reduces engagement to lower the risk of making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 出错就证明我not适合参加体育活动。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被视为有能力并被接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被看到、被他人评判和羞辱
defense_goal: 通过降低期待与Self-denial来避免更强烈的羞耻感
保持谨慎和回避脆弱暴露以维持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 容易出错、能力not足的参与者
object_relations.object_representation: Others with evaluative and critical gazes (classmates/coaches/peers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment of practicing at home and recording it
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries this will become a 'test' of ability; once failed, will be negatively evaluated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气稳定且接纳，先Empathy其担心，再将实验框定为“学习而非测验”，use具体、可实现的小步骤，强调失败也提供信息。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to describe strong feelings such as embarrassment and shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为暴露脆弱会带来not适或被看作“软弱”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 放慢节奏，use温和Questioning，引导命名感受；适度沉默留出体验空间，验证其安全感并允许部分表达。

In sports contexts, isolates his own experience with self-labels; feels isolated inside

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 在咨询中频繁Self-doubt并反复询问“如果我还是not变好怎么办”
对行为实验持观望态度，谨慎承诺

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: 把对外表达困扰的冲动收回，not向好友表达Self-doubt
通过自责和给自己贴标签将能量Turning against the self
